lessons.title: Morning Routine
lessons.context: A short story about Ayşe's morning routine.

paragraphs.tr: Ayşe her sabah saat yedide uyanır.
paragraphs.en: Ayşe wakes up at seven every morning.

paragraphs.tr: Önce yüzünü yıkar ve dişlerini fırçalar.
paragraphs.en: First she washes her face and brushes her teeth.

paragraphs.tr: Sonra mutfağa gider ve kahvaltı hazırlar.
paragraphs.en: Then she goes to the kitchen and prepares breakfast.

paragraphs.tr: Kahvaltıda peynir, zeytin ve ekmek yer.
paragraphs.en: For breakfast she eats cheese, olives, and bread.

paragraphs.tr: Saat sekizde evden çıkar ve işe gider.
paragraphs.en: At eight o'clock she leaves the house and goes to work.

questions.question: What time does Ayşe wake up?
What does she do first?
options: Washes her face and brushes her teeth

questions.question: What does she eat for breakfast?
What time does she leave the house?

lessons.title: Family
lessons.context: A short story about Mehmet's family.

paragraphs.tr: Mehmet'in büyük bir ailesi var.
paragraphs.en: Mehmet has a big family.

paragraphs.tr: Annesi öğretmen, babası ise doktordur.
paragraphs.en: His mother is a teacher, and his father is a doctor.

paragraphs.tr: Bir ablası ve bir erkek kardeşi var.
paragraphs.en: He has an older sister and a younger brother.

paragraphs.tr: Hafta sonları büyükanne ve büyükbabasını ziyaret ederler.
paragraphs.en: On weekends they visit his grandmother and grandfather.

paragraphs.tr: Aile birlikte yemek yemeyi çok sever.
paragraphs.en: The family loves eating together very much.

questions.question: What is Mehmet's mother's job?
What is his father's job?
How many siblings does Mehmet have?
Who do they visit on weekends?

lessons.title: At the Market
lessons.context: A short story about Fatma's weekly shopping trip.

paragraphs.tr: Fatma pazar günleri markete gider.
paragraphs.en: Fatma goes to the market on Sundays.

paragraphs.tr: Taze meyve ve sebze almayı sever.
paragraphs.en: She likes buying fresh fruit and vegetables.

paragraphs.tr: Bu hafta domates, salatalık ve elma aldı.
paragraphs.en: This week she bought tomatoes, cucumbers, and apples.

paragraphs.tr: Market çok kalabalıktı ama fiyatlar uygundu.
paragraphs.en: The market was very crowded, but the prices were reasonable.

paragraphs.tr: Eve döndükten sonra alışverişini buzdolabına koydu.
paragraphs.en: After returning home, she put her groceries in the fridge.

questions.question: When does Fatma go to the market?
What did she buy this week?
How was the market?
What did she do after returning home?

lessons.title: Weather
lessons.context: A short story about a cold, windy day.

paragraphs.tr: Bugün hava çok soğuk ve rüzgarlı.
paragraphs.en: Today the weather is very cold and windy.

paragraphs.tr: Gökyüzü gri ve yağmur yağabilir.
paragraphs.en: The sky is gray and it might rain.

paragraphs.tr: Ali kalın bir mont ve atkı giydi.
paragraphs.en: Ali wore a thick coat and a scarf.

paragraphs.tr: Yarın hava biraz daha ılık olacak.
paragraphs.en: Tomorrow the weather will be a little warmer.

paragraphs.tr: Ali hafta sonu güneşli havayı bekliyor.
paragraphs.en: Ali is waiting for sunny weather this weekend.

questions.question: How is the weather today?
What might happen?
What did Ali wear?
What is Ali waiting for?

lessons.title: Favorite Foods
lessons.context: A short story about a family's favorite meal.

paragraphs.tr: Benim en sevdiğim yemek mercimek çorbasıdır.
paragraphs.en: My favorite food is lentil soup.

paragraphs.tr: Annem her Cuma bu çorbayı pişirir.
paragraphs.en: My mother cooks this soup every Friday.

paragraphs.tr: Çorbanın yanında taze ekmek yeriz.
paragraphs.en: We eat fresh bread with the soup.

paragraphs.tr: Tatlı olarak da sütlaç severim.
paragraphs.en: For dessert, I also like rice pudding.

paragraphs.tr: Yemekten sonra ailemle çay içeriz.
paragraphs.en: After the meal, we drink tea with my family.

questions.question: What is the narrator's favorite food?
Who cooks the soup?
When is the soup cooked?
What do they drink after the meal?

lessons.title: Weekend Plans
lessons.context: A short story about Zeynep's plans with friends.

paragraphs.tr: Bu hafta sonu Zeynep ve arkadaşları sinemaya gidecek.
paragraphs.en: This weekend Zeynep and her friends will go to the cinema.

paragraphs.tr: Önce güzel bir restoranda yemek yiyecekler.
paragraphs.en: First they will eat at a nice restaurant.

paragraphs.tr: Filmden sonra parkta biraz yürüyecekler.
paragraphs.en: After the movie, they will walk a little in the park.

paragraphs.tr: Pazar günü Zeynep evde dinlenmeyi planlıyor.
paragraphs.en: On Sunday, Zeynep plans to rest at home.

paragraphs.tr: Ödevlerini de pazar akşamı bitirecek.
paragraphs.en: She will also finish her homework on Sunday evening.

questions.question: Where will Zeynep and her friends go this weekend?
What will they do first?
What will they do after the movie?
What does Zeynep plan to do on Sunday?

lessons.title: A Day at School
lessons.context: A short story about Can's typical school day.

paragraphs.tr: Okul saat sekiz buçukta başlar.
paragraphs.en: School starts at half past eight.

paragraphs.tr: Can ilk dersinde matematik çalışır.
paragraphs.en: Can studies math in his first class.

paragraphs.tr: Teneffüste arkadaşlarıyla bahçede oynar.
paragraphs.en: During the break, he plays in the yard with his friends.

paragraphs.tr: Öğle yemeğinde okul kantininden sandviç alır.
paragraphs.en: For lunch, he buys a sandwich from the school cafeteria.

paragraphs.tr: Dersler saat üçte biter ve eve döner.
paragraphs.en: Classes end at three, and he returns home.

questions.question: What time does school start?
What does Can study first?
What does he do during the break?
options: Plays in the yard with friends

questions.question: What time do classes end?

lessons.title: Going to Work
lessons.context: A short story about Emre's daily commute.

paragraphs.tr: Emre her gün otobüsle işe gider.
paragraphs.en: Emre goes to work by bus every day.

paragraphs.tr: Ev ile iş arası yaklaşık kırk dakika sürer.
paragraphs.en: The distance between home and work takes about forty minutes.

paragraphs.tr: Otobüste genellikle kitap okur veya müzik dinler.
paragraphs.en: On the bus, he usually reads a book or listens to music.

paragraphs.tr: Bazen otobüs çok kalabalık olur.
paragraphs.en: Sometimes the bus gets very crowded.

paragraphs.tr: İşe saat dokuzda başlar ve altıda biter.
paragraphs.en: Work starts at nine and ends at six.

questions.question: How does Emre go to work?
How long does the trip take?
What does he do on the bus?
What time does work end?

lessons.title: New Home
lessons.context: A short story about Elif's family moving house.

paragraphs.tr: Elif'in ailesi geçen ay yeni bir eve taşındı.
paragraphs.en: Elif's family moved to a new house last month.

paragraphs.tr: Yeni evin büyük bir bahçesi var.
paragraphs.en: The new house has a big garden.

paragraphs.tr: Elif'in artık kendi odası var.
paragraphs.en: Elif now has her own room.

paragraphs.tr: Oda pembe ve çok aydınlık.
paragraphs.en: The room is pink and very bright.

paragraphs.tr: Elif yeni evi çok seviyor.
paragraphs.en: Elif loves the new house very much.

lessons.title: Neighbors
lessons.context: A short story about a friendly street of neighbors.

paragraphs.tr: Bizim sokakta çok arkadaş canlısı komşular var.
paragraphs.en: There are very friendly neighbors on our street.

paragraphs.tr: Yan komşumuz Hasan Bey her sabah bahçesini sular.
paragraphs.en: Our next-door neighbor Hasan Bey waters his garden every morning.

paragraphs.tr: Karşı komşumuz bize sık sık kek getirir.
paragraphs.en: The neighbor across the street often brings us cake.

paragraphs.tr: Geçen hafta sonu birlikte sokak partisi yaptık.
paragraphs.en: Last weekend we had a street party together.

paragraphs.tr: Herkes birbirine yardım etmeyi sever.
paragraphs.en: Everyone likes helping each other.

questions.question: What does Hasan Bey do every morning?
What does the neighbor across the street often bring?

lessons.title: My Pet
lessons.context: A short story about a beloved pet cat.

paragraphs.tr: Benim küçük bir kedim var, adı Pamuk.
paragraphs.en: I have a small cat named Pamuk.

paragraphs.tr: Pamuk her gün çok uyur ve az oynar.
paragraphs.en: Pamuk sleeps a lot and plays little every day.

paragraphs.tr: En sevdiği yemek balıktır.
paragraphs.en: His favorite food is fish.

paragraphs.tr: Akşamları pencerede oturup dışarıyı izler.
paragraphs.en: In the evenings, he sits on the windowsill and watches outside.

paragraphs.tr: Ben onu çok seviyorum ve her gün besliyorum.
paragraphs.en: I love him very much and feed him every day.

questions.question: What is the cat's name?
What does the cat do a lot every day?
What is his favorite food?
What does he do in the evenings?
options: Sits on the windowsill and watches outside

lessons.title: Doing Sports
lessons.context: A short story about Burak's active lifestyle.

paragraphs.tr: Burak her sabah koşuya çıkar.
paragraphs.en: Burak goes running every morning.

paragraphs.tr: Haftada iki kez de yüzmeye gider.
paragraphs.en: He also goes swimming twice a week.

paragraphs.tr: Spor yapmak ona enerji verir.
paragraphs.en: Doing sports gives him energy.

paragraphs.tr: Cumartesi günleri arkadaşlarıyla futbol oynar.
paragraphs.en: On Saturdays, he plays football with his friends.

paragraphs.tr: Spordan sonra kendini çok iyi hissediyor.
paragraphs.en: After sports, he feels very good.

lessons.title: Birthday Party
lessons.context: A short story about Selin's upcoming birthday.

paragraphs.tr: Yarın Selin'in on ikinci doğum günü.
paragraphs.en: Tomorrow is Selin's twelfth birthday.

paragraphs.tr: Ailesi evde küçük bir parti hazırlıyor.
paragraphs.en: Her family is preparing a small party at home.

paragraphs.tr: Arkadaşları hediyeler ve balonlar getirecek.
paragraphs.en: Her friends will bring gifts and balloons.

paragraphs.tr: Annesi büyük bir çikolatalı pasta yapacak.
paragraphs.en: Her mother will make a big chocolate cake.

paragraphs.tr: Selin partiyi sabırsızlıkla bekliyor.
paragraphs.en: Selin is waiting for the party impatiently.

lessons.title: Phone Call
lessons.context: A short story about a mother-daughter phone call.

paragraphs.tr: Derya akşam annesini telefonla aradı.
paragraphs.en: Derya called her mother on the phone in the evening.

paragraphs.tr: Uzun zamandır konuşmamışlardı.
paragraphs.en: They hadn't talked for a long time.

paragraphs.tr: Annesi işleri ve sağlığı hakkında sorular sordu.
paragraphs.en: Her mother asked questions about her work and health.

paragraphs.tr: Derya yeni işinden çok memnun olduğunu söyledi.
paragraphs.en: Derya said she was very happy with her new job.

paragraphs.tr: Konuşmanın sonunda bir sonraki hafta buluşmaya karar verdiler.
paragraphs.en: At the end of the conversation, they decided to meet the following week.

questions.question: Who did Derya call?

lessons.title: Vacation Plan
lessons.context: A short story about Kerem's summer vacation plans.

paragraphs.tr: Kerem yaz tatilinde denize gitmeyi planlıyor.
paragraphs.en: Kerem is planning to go to the seaside during summer vacation.

paragraphs.tr: Ailesiyle Antalya'da bir otelde kalacaklar.
paragraphs.en: He and his family will stay at a hotel in Antalya.

paragraphs.tr: Her gün denizde yüzmeyi ve güneşlenmeyi düşünüyor.
paragraphs.en: He is thinking of swimming and sunbathing in the sea every day.

paragraphs.tr: Akşamları da şehir merkezinde yürüyüş yapacaklar.
paragraphs.en: In the evenings, they will also take walks in the city center.

paragraphs.tr: Kerem tatili çok merak ediyor.
paragraphs.en: Kerem is very excited about the vacation.

lessons.title: At the Restaurant
lessons.context: A short story about a Friday-night dinner with friends.

paragraphs.tr: Cuma akşamı arkadaşlarla küçük bir lokantaya gittik.
paragraphs.en: On Friday evening, we went to a small restaurant with friends.

paragraphs.tr: Garson bize menüyü getirdi.
paragraphs.en: The waiter brought us the menu.

paragraphs.tr: Ben tavuklu pilav, arkadaşım ise balık ısmarladı.
paragraphs.en: I ordered chicken with rice, and my friend ordered fish.

paragraphs.tr: Yemekler çok lezzetliydi ve hızlı geldi.
paragraphs.en: The food was very delicious and came quickly.

paragraphs.tr: Yemekten sonra hesabı bölüşerek ödedik.
paragraphs.en: After the meal, we split the bill.

lessons.title: At the Library
lessons.context: A short story about students studying for an exam.

paragraphs.tr: Öğrenciler sınav için kütüphaneye gitti.
paragraphs.en: The students went to the library for the exam.

paragraphs.tr: Kütüphane çok sessiz ve düzenliydi.
paragraphs.en: The library was very quiet and organized.

paragraphs.tr: Herkes kendi kitabını veya notlarını çalıştı.
paragraphs.en: Everyone studied their own book or notes.

paragraphs.tr: Birkaç saat sonra kısa bir ara verdiler.
paragraphs.en: After a few hours, they took a short break.

paragraphs.tr: Akşama kadar orada çalışmaya devam ettiler.
paragraphs.en: They continued studying there until the evening.

lessons.title: At the Bus Stop
lessons.context: A short story about a cold, delayed morning commute.

paragraphs.tr: Sabah erkenden otobüs durağında bekliyordum.
paragraphs.en: I was waiting at the bus stop early in the morning.

paragraphs.tr: Hava soğuktu ve rüzgar esiyordu.
paragraphs.en: It was cold and windy.

paragraphs.tr: Otobüs beklediğimden daha geç geldi.
paragraphs.en: The bus came later than I expected.

paragraphs.tr: Otobüste boş yer yoktu, bu yüzden ayakta durdum.
paragraphs.en: There were no empty seats on the bus, so I stood.

paragraphs.tr: İşe yaklaşık on dakika geç kaldım.
paragraphs.en: I was about ten minutes late for work.

lessons.title: Seasons
lessons.context: A short story describing the four seasons in Turkey.

paragraphs.tr: Türkiye'de dört mevsim yaşanır.
paragraphs.en: Turkey experiences four seasons.

paragraphs.tr: İlkbaharda hava ılık olur ve çiçekler açar.
paragraphs.en: In spring, the weather is mild and flowers bloom.

paragraphs.tr: Yaz sıcak geçer, insanlar denize gider.
paragraphs.en: Summer is hot, and people go to the seaside.

paragraphs.tr: Sonbaharda yapraklar sararır ve dökülür.
paragraphs.en: In autumn, the leaves turn yellow and fall.

paragraphs.tr: Kış soğuk ve bazen karlı olur.
paragraphs.en: Winter is cold and sometimes snowy.

lessons.title: A Letter
lessons.context: A short story about writing a letter to a distant friend.

paragraphs.tr: Ahmet uzaktaki arkadaşına bir mektup yazdı.
paragraphs.en: Ahmet wrote a letter to his distant friend.

paragraphs.tr: Mektupta okulundan ve yeni arkadaşlarından bahsetti.
paragraphs.en: In the letter, he talked about his school and new friends.

paragraphs.tr: Ayrıca yakında ziyarete gelmesini istedi.
paragraphs.en: He also asked him to come visit soon.

paragraphs.tr: Mektubu bir zarfa koyup postaneye götürdü.
paragraphs.en: He put the letter in an envelope and took it to the post office.

paragraphs.tr: Bir hafta sonra arkadaşından cevap geldi.
paragraphs.en: A week later, a reply came from his friend.
